name: text-edit-markdown
title: Text Edit Markdown
description: VegaStack Markdown v1 in and out of a TextEdit document, identical in a browser and on a server — markdownToDoc, docToMarkdown, normalizeMarkdown, docToText, an isolated marked instance, minimal escaping, raw HTML as text, and the editor’s VegaStackMarkdown extension.

meta.whenToUse: Converting between Markdown and a TextEdit document on a server — import, export, search text, a collaboration server’s read copy.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rendering Markdown to read — use MarkdownView.
